caption:
The foam test takes three seconds and no tools.

Press the middle of a seat cushion, let go, count to three. Good foam comes back level. Cheap foam keeps the hollow you just made, and it keeps every hollow after that. The fabric goes slack once the foam underneath has given up.

Two numbers tell you before you buy. Compression set is how much height the foam loses for good. Support factor is deep firmness divided by surface firmness, and the Polyurethane Foam Association says 2.0 or above is better suited for furniture seat cushions.

Foam seats only. A down cushion is meant to hold a dent.

Save this for the showroom.
